description: Use when a name fails validation or the person asks whether its DNSSEC chain holds. Returns each signed zone cut from the root to the answer and the first link that breaks, or where it goes insecure.

name.description: The name, e.g. www.example.com. Also accepted as "domain"; a URL is reduced to its host.

type.description: The record type to check at the end of the chain

name: dnssec_chain
title: Walk the DNSSEC chain
